GTA 6, which the gaming world had been waiting for for 13 years, caused a huge worldwide stir with its release on November 19. The emergence of a drawing resembling a UFO on the map of the game, which attracted attention with its record-breaking promotional videos and vast open world, created excitement among players. While Rockstar Games has not yet confirmed that UFOs are in the game, millions of players focused on solving the mystery of the mysterious detail.

GTA 6, which Rockstar Games developed after GTA 5, released in 2013, launched for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S on November 19, 2026. The game, which had been on the agenda for years due to its long development process and delayed release date, began its global launch process, especially after becoming available in New Zealand. While internet providers prepare for heavy download traffic for the production, which also stands out with its 212-gigabyte file size, the game's release has caused a major stir in the technology and entertainment sectors.

UFO DETAIL IN GTA 6 SPARKS EXCITEMENT

Shortly before the game's release, a map belonging to collectible products displayed at the Selfridges store in the UK did not escape players' attention. The presence of a drawing resembling a flying saucer in the Breakwater Quarry area of the map showing the state of Leonida sparked debates that UFOs might be present in GTA 6. Images shared on social media quickly spread among players, and many thought that the area in question could host a secret mission connected to aliens.

ARE UFOS REALLY IN THE GAME?

Although the UFO drawing seen on the GTA 6 map draws attention, Rockstar Games has not made an official statement regarding whether aliens can be encountered or UFOs can be used in the game. While it is stated that the image on the map may only be a decorative element, players assess that it could point to a secret area or a special mission. Social media posts claiming that UFOs are in the game have not yet been independently verified.

GTA 5 ALSO HAD A UFO MYSTERY

GTA 5, the series' previous game, plays a significant role in the growth of the UFO debate. In GTA 5, players could encounter flying saucers at different points on the map when they met certain conditions. In particular, the mysterious drawings found on Mount Chiliad and the UFO images that appeared after completing the game were the subject of players' investigations for years. The idea that a similar mystery could be found in GTA 6 led fans of the series to examine the details on the new game's map.

PROMOTIONAL VIDEOS BROKE RECORDS

Even before its release, GTA 6 became one of the most talked-about productions in the gaming industry. The first promotional video, published in December 2023, reached over 93 million views on YouTube in the first 24 hours, breaking a record in the non-music video category. The second promotional video, published in May 2025, received more than 475 million views in the first 24 hours across different platforms. The game's trailers became a topic not only for players but also for technology and entertainment media worldwide.

VICE CITY IS AT THE CENTER OF THE GAME

GTA 6 takes place in the fictional region of Leonida, inspired by the US state of Florida. Returning to Vice City, one of the series' unforgettable cities, players encounter a world notable for its vast coastal areas, crowded streets, swamps, small towns, and nightlife. The game's story, meanwhile, revolves around two characters named Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval. After a failed criminal venture, the pair find themselves in the middle of a major conspiracy and must act together to survive.

THE GIANT SERIES THAT SOLD MORE THAN 470 MILLION

The Grand Theft Auto series has reached over 470 million sales worldwide, becoming one of the most successful brands in gaming history. The series' previous game, GTA 5, alone achieved more than 230 million sales. GTA 6's release drew attention not only among players but also in financial markets. While shares of Rockstar Games' parent company Take-Two Interactive rose by more than 8 percent, the game is expected to be one of the entertainment industry's biggest commercial launches.

MILLIONS OF PLAYERS ARE IN PURSUIT OF HIDDEN DETAILS

With GTA 6's release, players have begun discovering hidden areas, surprise missions, and references to previous games in the vast open world. The Breakwater Quarry area, where the UFO drawing is located, particularly attracts the attention of mystery enthusiasts. Rockstar Games' frequent inclusion of hidden missions and unexpected encounters in its past games increases the expectation of exploration in the new title. The answer to the UFO debate will become clear through discoveries made in the game world.
